headline: Sul Ross State alone in the division without a goal
dek: Sul Ross State lost again, this time to UT Dallas, and are still waiting for a goal this season. They have conceded twenty-five, and every other programme in the division has scored.
displaced_by: results night: Sul Ross State lose to UT Dallas and remain the only programme in the division yet to score
